tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch13.label: Chapter 13
card.ch13.title: The Index
end.ch13.title: End of Chapter 13
end.ch13.body:
A leaf, a tag, a letter: the memories for the last page are gathered.
In Chapter 14 the Proofreader arrives with his red pen. And the Pencil with her eraser.
page.p39.title: Index
page.p39.intro: Each entry refers to the place where it is covered. Tap an entry to go there.
page.p39.margin: the index is the map of the book. at last it's useful
page.p40.title: Words for the last page
page.p40.intro: A memory from each place we changed. They're needed to write the last page.
page.p40.leaf: • a leaf (from the plant that took offence)
page.p40.tag: • an "8 m" tag (from the bridge that was too short)
plant.prompt: The plant is still offended. What do you say?
n.i1: We're back in the Starting Room. The door-shaped hole is still there.
p.i1: to write the last page we need real words. memories. one from every place we changed.
n.i2: Then we need the index. Page 39. The most useful thing I've ever written.
n.i3: Each entry takes you to a place. Tap the entry and you're there. Make yourself comfortable: it's a chapter of memories.
n.ravine1: The Scenic Ravine. The bridge is still eight metres long. Approved errata.
p.ravine: the "8 m" tag. that's a good memory.
n.ws1: The Assembly Workshop. This is where we built the Hero.
n.ws2: Yes, you were born here. Don't get emotional. And look under the table: something fell off the poster.
n.room_empty: The Starting Room. Smaller than I remembered.
n.ravine_empty: The ravine. Don't look down, not even now.
n.ws_empty: The workshop. It still smells of apple.
n.page_wrong: Not on this page. Memories go on page 40.
n.tool1: No arrows today. Today we remember.
n.typo_index: "Idnex". The index got its own entry wrong. Now that's a memory.
n.typo_souv: "Memmories". One M too many. Remembering too much is bad for spelling.
n.hole: The hole where the door was. The Proofreader never filled it. Not even with the errata.
n.plant_still: The plant. It still turns its leaves away. It remembers you.
n.plant_ok: The plant has forgiven you. It offers you a leaf. Take it, it's a gift.
n.plant_no: The plant is even more offended. I didn't think that was possible.
n.plant_leaf: The plant holds out a leaf. Take it to page 40.
n.plant_bye: The plant waves with one leaf fewer. It's happy. More or less.
n.tag: The "8 m" tag. You can take it: the errata still stand without it.
n.bridge: Eight metres of bridge. All yours.
n.o: A huge O, under the table. The one missing from... well, it fell off the poster.
n.poster: "SMALL PRATS". An O fell on the floor. It doesn't even belong there. Typical.
n.poster_after: The poster is still wrong. But the O is ours now.
n.platform: The test platform. This is where the Hero said his first word.
n.put_leaf: A leaf from the offended plant. The first memory.
n.put_tag: The "8 m" tag. The bridge stays long without it.
n.put_o: The O. A letter lost to a typo. Now it has a place.
p.more: some are still missing. the index is on page 39.
n.x1: A leaf, a tag, a letter. They don't look like much.
p.x1: they're our best mistakes. they're enough.
c.x1: You've gathered your memories. Very well.
c.x2: The last page is at the back of the book. I'll be waiting there. With the red pen.
n.x2: A meeting on the last page. Just like in real books.
h.leaf.1: In the Starting Room (index, page 39) the plant is still offended.
h.leaf.2: An offended plant gives no leaves. Maybe an apology will do.
h.leaf.3: Tap the plant, choose "Sorry, plant.", then drag the leaf to page 40.
h.tag.1: At the Scenic Ravine (index, page 39) there's a memory hanging from the bridge.
h.tag.2: The "8 m" tag at the end of the bridge comes off.
h.tag.3: Drag the "8 m" tag to page 40.
h.o.1: In the Workshop (index, page 39) something fell off the poster.
h.o.2: There's a big letter lying around. Look under the table.
h.o.3: Drag the O from under the table to page 40.
